storyInfo: The police appear as the protests intensify, quelling the protest and arresting Sonya. Before the ball starts, Witte is informed of an imminent assassination plot against the Emperor, only to find the Emperor has vanished by the time he arrives.

attributes.content: Free Rania! Free all political prisoners!
attributes.name: Ursus Student

attributes.content: Release the reserves! Share the energy! Heat for all the people!
attributes.name: Ursus Student

attributes.content: Excuse me, pardon me, let me pass...
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: Zima! Istina! Where are you...?
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: Liberty for the people! Bread for the people!
attributes.name: Ursus Student

attributes.content: Today's silence is tomorrow's slavery! Make our voices heard!
attributes.name: Ursus Student

attributes.content: Show yourselves! We demand parley!
attributes.name: Ursus Student

attributes.content: I believe those present know the rest better than I do.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: The ballroom was in chaos. In their panic, some attendees removed their gowns, snatched women's hats out of the servants' hands and ran outside...
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: Preposterous! You weren't even at the ball! Who told you these rumors?
attributes.name: Angry Noble

attributes.content: They're all over the police force, and it's hard to tell where they come from. I offer you my apologies, if the rumors are unsubstantiated—
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: Not me!
attributes.name: Angry Noble

attributes.content: N-Not to me! Apologize to everyone who was at the ball!
attributes.name: Angry Noble

attributes.content: Order!
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: This hearing is not interested in street rumors. It is what happened with the students that we wish to know.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: For example, who spoke those foul words of sedition?
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Which words?
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: Which else? The foulest, most treacherous ones.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: People were saying all sorts of things. I'm not sure what you're referring to—
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: The most treasonous, blasphemous, sacrilegious words... the ones that no one in this room may utter!
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Oh, I get it.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: Death to the mudak Emperor!
attributes.name: Angry Student
Angry Student
attributes.content: Death to the mudak Emperor!

attributes.name: Angry Student
attributes.content: Death to the mudak Emperor!

attributes.name: Angry Student
attributes.content: Death to the mudak Emperor!
Death to the Hippogryph-blooded filth! Ursus belongs to the Ursus!
attributes.name: Leonid

attributes.content: Bring out the bloodsucker Witte! Bring out the imbecile Fyodor!
attributes.name: Angry Student

attributes.content: You mean to say every student blasphemed against His Imperial Majesty that night.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Maybe, other than the few who kept cool heads. The young can be hot-blooded, and become incited to speak with a voice that does not belong to them.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: Or perhaps you are exaggerating in order to cover up for a few of their number.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: I am only telling the truth. You're jumping to some shocking conclusions.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: Let us go back to the previous statement. You explained why Baryshnya Rostova failed to notice His Imperial Majesty's absence. Do you know where he was?
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: I learned a few things through my police contacts, but they are vague and uncertain.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: You know of his whereabouts?
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: I know he was in the palace, but not why he did not appear at the ball as scheduled.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: No, you know.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: I'm sorry?
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: My evidence indicates that the Deity Grypherburg Police Night's Watch was the first to learn of His Imperial Majesty's disappearance, which means that you, too, were in a position to know.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Answer, Young Zoya. Why are you hiding the truth about the attempt on the Emperor's life, and his subsequent disappearance during the protests in question?
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Well...
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: If you knew, your friend, Sonya Mykhailivna, knew too.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Was the violence that she incited in the quarantine zone aimed at finishing what the assassin attempt began?
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: (Murmurs) So the Emperor went missing that night. That explains everything.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: ...What?
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Natalya mentioned something in particular. Before the protests began, she was heading to where the chairman and vice chairman were, but her attention, like the others, was drawn to the light outside the window.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: Both of them had left by the time she looked back.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: Day of the hearing, a Tsarevgrad Office
If you don't want to appear at the hearing, I can go in your place, at least minimize the impact of the Emperor's disappearance by influencing the direction of the hearing.
attributes.name: Vasily

attributes.content: There is no longer a need to hide, Vasha.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Virtually every major noble in Grypherburg has learned about His Imperial Majesty's 'act of whimsy'. No number of gag orders will wipe away the shock that the event has caused.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Right now, I don't give two hoots about the hearing or the public opinion. The only thing on my mind is His Majesty's safety. You must find out what happened that day, before we move to eliminate the issues that put the Emperor in danger.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: It was more than just Grypherburg's guards that went out of control that day. It was a warning sign, and a lesson to learn from.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Forgive my imprudence, Chairman Witte, but I understand that you had an argument with His Imperial Majesty prior to the ball, where he expressed his displeasure with the State Council's handling of the Katorga matter.
attributes.name: Vasily

attributes.content: If that is what you are referring to, people on the outside would not be surprised, for His Imperial Majesty is ever caring of all who walk upon this land, even if his kindness is often mistaken for weakness.
attributes.name: Vasily

attributes.content: No, not that.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: His Majesty was indeed in a bad mood, but he agreed to attend the ball, until I received a tip prior to the event—
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Someone was attempting to place an Originium bomb in the ballroom. He was caught by a maintenance worker.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Attempting to assassinate His Imperial Majesty?
attributes.name: Vasily

attributes.content: It is not so simple. I thought the same as you did, so I followed emergency protocols and instructed the Royal Guard to go to His Majesty's chambers and escort him through the underground tunnel, while I interrogated the assassin personally.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: He claimed he was here to assassinate Baron Kamshalov, at the behest of the baroness.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: It would be a captivating family drama, if circumstances were different...
attributes.name: Vasily

attributes.content: As the interrogation continued, however, he mentioned something even more unsettling—
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Damn... come on, Geil, keep it together, you can do it...
attributes.name: Nervous Assassin

attributes.content: Crouched on the floor, he wipes the sweat from his eyes, while haphazard parts are scattered across the red carpet.
A round 'alarm clock', three sticks of explosives bundled together like sausages, and numerous wires. A simple bomb that even a novice could assemble by following the instructions.
But the sweat has soaked through the paper he is holding, blurring the writing to illegibility.
Okay, I can still read this... connect the blue wire, then the green one, then a funt of... a funt of...
attributes.name: Nervous Assassin

attributes.content: A funt of canned stew?
attributes.name: Nervous Assassin

attributes.content: Blyat! Ivan! The baroness paid so much, and you're passing off a recipe as bombmaking instructions?!
attributes.name: Nervous Assassin

attributes.content: Alright, calm down, it's up to me now... maybe this green one goes into this connector.
attributes.name: Nervous Assassin

attributes.content: Wrong, the green one goes below the blue one.
Let's give that a try...
attributes.name: Nervous Assassin

attributes.content: It worked! Thank you, kind-hearted—
attributes.name: Nervous Assassin

attributes.content: Who the khuy are you?
attributes.name: Nervous Assassin

attributes.content: (Hushed) Calm down and don't yell! Do you want to bring the whole police force down on our heads?
attributes.name: Relaxed Assassin

attributes.content: I had to stop you. If you really put that wire in, we'd have one more, no, two more 'canned stews' here in this room.
attributes.name: Relaxed Assassin

attributes.content: Don't worry, we're fellow travelers, I'm not gonna sell you out.
attributes.name: Relaxed Assassin

attributes.content: We're what?
attributes.name: Nervous Assassin

attributes.content: Are you in a noblewoman's pocket too?
attributes.name: Nervous Assassin

attributes.content: What are you talking about? We're both assassins, aren't we?
attributes.name: Relaxed Assassin

attributes.content: Sorry, I... it's my first time. I'm not really familiar with this stuff.
attributes.name: Nervous Assassin

attributes.content: Hey, everybody's gotta start somewhere. Who's your debut job? Is it a big one?
attributes.name: Relaxed Assassin

attributes.content: I don't know if he's big or not. All I know is that he's a baron with a casino.
attributes.name: Nervous Assassin

attributes.content: Well, that's not a bad one to pop your cherry. You'll get jobs for bigger fins with some practice under your belt.
attributes.name: Relaxed Assassin

attributes.content: What about you?
attributes.name: Nervous Assassin

attributes.content: Heh, cover your mouth first. Don't want you freaking out and drawing unwanted attention.
attributes.name: Relaxed Assassin

attributes.content: (Hushed) I'm here to kill Duchess Volkina.
attributes.name: Relaxed Assassin

attributes.content: Who's that?
attributes.name: Nervous Assassin

attributes.content: ...What?
attributes.name: Relaxed Assassin

attributes.content: You don't know her?!
attributes.name: Relaxed Assassin

attributes.content: Quiet, quiet—
attributes.name: Nervous Assassin

attributes.content: She's one of the few hereditary dukes in Ursus, a thorn in the side of the old guard nobility, and blood relative to the Emperor himself!
attributes.name: Relaxed Assassin

attributes.content: Okay, okay, don't shout, I'm sorry...
attributes.name: Nervous Assassin

attributes.content: My employer searched across all of Ursus for an assassin who could take the job, and I was the only one who would do it! How could you—
attributes.name: Relaxed Assassin

attributes.content: ...You—
attributes.name: Nervous Assassin

attributes.content: Shh—
...Shh?
attributes.name: Nervous Assassin

attributes.content: The surprise visitor shakes his head and gestures to the table on the other side. The nervous assassin hesitates, then walks over slowly.
Give it to me.
You want this bread?
attributes.name: Nervous Assassin

attributes.content: The man shakes his head.
Don't tell me you want the table knife?
attributes.name: Nervous Assassin

attributes.content: The man nods.
Wait, tell us what you're gonna do with it first. Giving a knife to a stranger is not exactly becoming of a professional assassin.
attributes.name: Relaxed Assassin

attributes.content: Give it to me, and I'll tell you.
The nervous assassin dares not approach. He tosses the knife to the man, who picks it up silently, then makes a sign with two fingers.
Go out the door, go through the kitchen, climb the ladder to the roof, and get into the room on the west side via the sunroof.
attributes.name: Relaxed Assassin

attributes.content: Shh—
...Shh.
attributes.name: Relaxed Assassin

attributes.content: The edge of the visitor's mouth twitches. He nods and departs, leaving behind the two stunned assassins.
What were you talking about? I didn't understand a word.
attributes.name: Nervous Assassin

attributes.content: He's here to kill... the Emperor.
attributes.name: Relaxed Assassin

attributes.content: So you mean palace security allowed all these myriad assassins into the ballroom, and it took a maintenance worker to discover them.
attributes.name: Vasily

attributes.content: How many more surprises do the Grypherburg's guards have in store for us?
attributes.name: Vasily

attributes.content: The capital-wide power outage happened soon after.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: While not entirely unexpected, given the recent energy shortage, it coincided with the matter of the assassins, which led to an overreaction.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: That is why, after we left the scene of the ball, I instructed you to head to police headquarters and search for suspicious persons amongst the protestors.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: You saw their crude, ineffective methods.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: It's a good thing that your daughter is hardworking and motivated. If she was unambitious and went into the Guard by pulling strings, you would be the one with the constant headaches.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: I am glad for Eloysius that you are willing to mentor her. Our entire family is very proud.
attributes.name: Vasily

attributes.content: But how could these absurdly incompetent assassins have affected His Imperial Majesty?
attributes.name: Vasily

attributes.content: Do you remember who I sent to find him, according to emergency procedures?
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: The Royal Guard?
attributes.name: Vasily

attributes.content: That's what I don't understand. Why would the Emperor need to flee, if he was protected by the Royal Guard?
attributes.name: Vasily

attributes.content: (Hushed) Because the loyalty of the Royal Guard is to Ursus, not the Emperor.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: What?
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Why are you still here?
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: You're late, Witte.
...Where is His Imperial Majesty? Did you not go with him?
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Your orders were to go to his room and guard against assassins.
attributes.name: 'Emperor's Blade'

attributes.content: I ordered you to protect the Emperor! This is a plan that's long been in place. In the event of any emergency, you are to personally escort him through the secret passage.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Unfortunately, your best intentions do not seem to be appreciated.
attributes.name: 'Emperor's Blade'

attributes.content: Do you mean...?
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Have you not realized, Chairman?
attributes.name: 'Emperor's Blade'

attributes.content: The one you're sworn to protect has been thoroughly disappointed by all that has happened here for years, decades even.
attributes.name: 'Emperor's Blade'

attributes.content: Of course, given your unreserved loyalty over such a long period of time, he would trust you, even if he sees all the other nobles as traitors.
attributes.name: 'Emperor's Blade'

attributes.content: But he will not put the same trust in me.
attributes.name: 'Emperor's Blade'

attributes.content: What happened to His Majesty?
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: He left by way of the secret passage, as planned, but he steadfastly refused my escort.
attributes.name: 'Emperor's Blade'

attributes.content: Didn't you stop him?
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Why would I stop him?
attributes.name: 'Emperor's Blade'

attributes.content: You may not understand how I think, but you should try to understand how he thinks, 'Caretaker'.
attributes.name: 'Emperor's Blade'

attributes.content: Let him go out and see for himself what Ursus is truly like, beyond the window.
attributes.name: 'Emperor's Blade'

attributes.content: Which means that His Imperial Majesty has disappeared from under the watch of the Royal Guard.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Even if it was of his own volition.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: The air itself seems thinner in the tightly packed formation of students, but they make room for their leader, Olga, giving a small but isolated space.
Fellow students! Unite and bring down the establishment!
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: The young noble lady stands proudly upon a battered oak casket, a faded family emblem faintly visible upon it.
Her shouting is drowned out by even more radical chants, but she squints as if to take in this Grypherburg night that belongs to them, until someone makes it to her side.
Time to put this to bed, Olga!
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Sonya?
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: No marching, not even unified slogans... I see booze in the crowd. This is too risky.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Don't pour cold water when morale is at its highest—
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: Listen to me! These streets are lined with noble townhouses. Look how narrow the path is, it'd make any retreat really bad.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: More than that, I haven't seen a single cop.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: There's more to this than we know. Let's march south, shout our chants that way. It'll be easier to respond to any surprises.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: I know what you're trying to say, but all this is normal. Faddey already explained that police operations are disrupted during the Winter Ball due to the personnel changes.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: Besides, given our background, activism for our friends' rights, within reason, is seen as a sort of youthful experience, not rebellion.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: Set your heart at ease and stand with us, Sonya.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: Right... given your background.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: If you're gonna be stubborn about this, I'll have to take the SSG and go.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: This is not like you, Sonya. I thought you would be the bravest and firmest at a time like this.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: We have caught their attention and left an impression. All that is left is to negotiate for Rania's release, and enjoy the fruits of victory.
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: If victory is so close, you can enjoy it yourself! No need to save any for me.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: No sooner has she said these words than the ballroom's lights turn off, plunging the scene into darkness. Several screams can be heard from inside, then hushed conversations and sobbing.
The students fall silent, looking at each other in bewilderment. This is the quietest moment of this Grypherburg evening.
Did your group do this, Sonya?
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: No, we didn't do anyth—
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Beautifully done!
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: I'll pretend I didn't hear what you said before. The Self-Government Group has done a great service to our protest!
attributes.name: Olga

attributes.content: She pats Zima's shoulder excitedly. Zima hears a soft, indistinct sound coming from the end of the street, so quiet that it is almost drowned out by Olga's patting.
...Look out!
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: She pulls Olga and runs. A few black cans fall to the ground, leaving light tracks on the snow, before emanating a white smoke.
The nearest student screams, his voice rasping, before it is interrupted by violent coughing as sulfuric smoke attacks his eyes, nose and mouth like tiny gravel.
Then another, and another, as more students find their sight and breath stolen, screaming and twitching as they clutch at their faces. The others cry out in terror and disperse.
Many have fallen to the ground, calling for their friends in vain. They press their faces to the stone and hear the sound of approaching footsteps.
Tear gas deployed! Take the injured, leave the rest!
The late-arriving guardsmen raise their flashlights, casting powerful beams of light upon the young, frightened faces of the students.
The students that can still move run to the end of the street, crying and screaming, half-stumbling and half-crawling, their clothes soiled with muddy snow, footsteps, even blood.
General! We're here!
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Let's go! It's a mess back there!
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Wait, where's Gummy?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: She went to look for you! Didn't you see her?
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: Blyat!
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Zima turns and charges into the chaotic crowd without a second thought, ignoring the calls of Istina and Leto behind her.
It takes some time for her to get back to where Olga was, a scene of bedlam with guardsmen clubbing the remaining resisters with nightsticks.
Gummy is standing in front of Zima, slowly walking to a policeman, staring at his stick-wielding hand.
Why is Papa's watch here...?
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: What did you do to him?!
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: —Freeze! Get on your knees!
attributes.name: Ursine Police

attributes.content: A nightstick swings for Gummy. She dodges instinctively and sees the man before her tackled to the ground by a black shadow, causing a slushy splash.
Zima?!
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: Run!
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Guardsman down! I need backup!
attributes.name: Ursine Police

attributes.content: A dozen guardsmen rush in from every direction, grabbing Zima's shoulders and trying to separate her from their colleague on the ground, but she does not budge in the slightest. They begin striking her in the back with their nightsticks.
Gotcha, Gummy!
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: What are you doing? Get away from her!
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Chase them off. We're pulling out.
attributes.name: Ursine Police

attributes.content: Sonya!
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: Have you lost your mind, Leto?!
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Get out of here! That's an order!
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Hmph... not gonna happen!
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Zima! No, I'm helping you—
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: Don't try to be a hero, Sonya! Take our hands!
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: You're out of your mind too? There's more of them back there, and they've got crossbows.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Retreat! That's an order!
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Don't try to pull rank with me! It won't work!
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: I need you to take them away, and the students out there need you! Help them!
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: That's not an order then. It's a favor, from a friend!
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Listen to me, just this once! Go—
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: ...And that's all that happened that night.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: Some here may find it hard to accept, but Sonya should be considered a victim in this incident, regardless of which angle you take.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: The parliamentarian has noted the witness's account, which will be used in conjunction with the statement Zoya previously submitted to compile an official report.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Any further questions for the witness?
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Your Honor, Young Zoya, perhaps some of us have misunderstood the purpose of the hearing.
attributes.name: Hearing Committee Member

attributes.content: The reason that many have called for the student groups' actions to recognized as treason is not the protest alone, but also their disruptive behavior in the quarantine zone.
attributes.name: Hearing Committee Member

attributes.content: Of foremost concern to us is this: Where was His Imperial Majesty Fyodor in the course of these events?
attributes.name: Hearing Committee Member

attributes.content: There have been various rumors running through the people, some claiming that His Majesty mobilized the students against the nobility.
attributes.name: Hearing Committee Member

attributes.content: I am therefore quite curious; for example, on the night of the protests, why did His Imperial Majesty—
attributes.name: Hearing Committee Member

attributes.content: Forgive the interruption, Count Troyan.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: I must emphasize that the Chairman will not be present today, in order to reduce the pressure on the committee, nor has he made any implicit suggestion.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: The reason I questioned the witness concerning His Imperial Majesty's whereabouts was only to understand the relationship between the attempted assassination, the Emperor's subsequent disappearance, and the actions of the student leader Sonya Mykhailivna.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: If the committee still has doubts, we can clarify them here and now.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Please answer, Young Zoya.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Do you think Sonya Mykhailivna's actions during the protest had anything to do with the assassination attempt on His Imperial Majesty or his disappearance?
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: The decision of the Royal Guard...
attributes.name: Vasily

attributes.content: The part that is most important, yet one that no one can know. It will not be part of the hearing's findings.
attributes.name: Vasily

attributes.content: Did His Majesty say anything to you upon his return?
attributes.name: Vasily

attributes.content: No, Vasha, no...
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: We can all see how taciturn he has become since.
attributes.name: Witte
